title: Security & Compliance review prep - 1:1 notes
content:
Purpose: prep notes for 1:1 with Emily (Compliance Lead) - align on SOC2/ISO readiness, vendor risk items, and next steps for audit evidence collection.

Meeting goals:
- Quick status check on SOC2 Type II timeline and blockers
- Confirm owner assignments for outstanding evidence (log retention, access reviews, change control)
- Clarify vendor risk assessment cadence and scope for top 10 vendors
- Agree on what we want to show auditors for the upcoming readiness review

Key context/context bullets:
- We kicked off SOC2 readiness program Q4 2025; primary gap areas last review were: formalized change control (CC6), logging/retention (L8), and vendor management (VM1).
- ISO scoping request submitted for infra and control plane only - not customer-managed private deployments.
- External auditor shortlist: A-Labs (preferred), B-Consulting (backup). Need decision by Mar 15 to lock engagement.

Questions for Emily (prioritized):
1) Timeline: Are we still targeting a base evidence package ready by Apr 15 for auditor intake? Any reason to push?
2) Evidence owners: Can we confirm the following owners now (to avoid back-and-forth):
   - Change control runbooks / approvals: @Samir (eng-release)
   - Logging config + retention proof (ELK/S3): @Alex (platform-eng)
   - Access reviews + SSO audit logs: @Priya (identity)
   - Vendor risk assessments (top 10): Compliance (Emily) + Eng leads for tech vendors
3) Vendor risk: For vendor list, do we want to include site reliability tooling (PagerDuty) and cloud infra partners (GCP/AWS) in the top 10? Any exclusions?
4) Evidence format: auditors prefer consolidated spreadsheet vs individual Confluence pages. Do we standardize on the auditor template (linked) or make a custom sheet?
5) ISO items: any blockers left for scoping (asset inventory completeness)?

Current evidence gaps (what I have noted):
- Change control: missing documented ROLES for approval gates on infra changes (esp. infra-as-code PR approvals). Need an example PR flow and a signed policy.
- Logging retention: we have logs in ELK for 90 days and archival to S3 for 1 year - need a written retention policy and screenshots of lifecycle rules.
- Access reviews: last full org review was 2025-10-10; we need a recent quarterly review exported CSV + remediation notes.
- Vendor risk: only 6/10 vendors have completed questionnaires; 2 have outstanding SOC reports to collect.

Draft asks / agenda items to align in 1:1:
- Decision: auditor selection (A-Labs vs B-Consulting) and next steps to engage
- Confirm owners for each evidence item and due dates (assignments below)
- Agreement on evidence repository/location (auditor sheet in shared drive vs Confluence)
- Vendor risk strategy: escalate top high-criticality vendors for SOC/Security docs collection; propose targeted outreach template
- Quick sync plan for weekly evidence check-ins (standup 30m)

Proposed owners & near-term due dates (please confirm in 1:1):
- Change control docs (policy + example PR flow): Samir - due 2026-03-12
- Logging retention policy + screenshots: Alex - due 2026-03-10
- Access review export + remediation log: Priya - due 2026-03-08
- Vendor questionnaires completion (remaining 4 vendors): Emily/Compliance - initial outreach by 2026-03-05, responses by 2026-03-19
- Evidence consolidation into auditor template: Jamie (me) + Emily - initial draft by 2026-03-15

Action items I will take if we agree in 1:1:
- Compile auditor intake spreadsheet template and pre-fill known items (deadline 2026-03-06)
- Draft vendor outreach email and questionnaire follow-up template (2026-03-05)
- Book weekly 30m evidence sync on Fridays (starting 2026-03-12)

Potential risks / blockers to raise:
- Resource constraints: Samir and Alex flagged other high-priority launches in March - may need to negotiate scope or push dates.
- Missing historical artifacts (older logs/archives) - may require retention confirmation from infra team.
- Vendor delays: some vendors take 2-4 weeks to surface SOC reports. Auditor intake window is tight.

Notes / talking points to surface in meeting:
- Emphasize auditor preference for a single consolidated evidence sheet - will reduce back-and-forth.
- Recommend prioritizing top 5 critical controls for early submission (change control, access reviews, logging, incident response, vendor mgmt).
- Suggest we request a short 'readiness check' from selected auditor (A-Labs) before formal engagement - small paid consult to catch blind spots.

Follow-ups to create after 1:1 (templates / docs I will generate):
- "SOC2-auditor-intake-template.xlsx" in shared drive
- Vendor outreach email + checklist (copy to compliance)
- Evidence tracking board (Jira board or sheet with status fields)

Misc notes / random thoughts (scratchpad):
- Could we leverage Dedicated customer paperwork to show segregation controls? Might help with control objectives on data separation.
- Consider automating periodic access review exports via a scheduled run in identity platform; ask Priya for feasibility.
- If auditor engagement cost is blocking, ask finance about a small fund reallocation for compliance professional services.

Ready to discuss these in 1:1. My meeting notes will become the source-of-truth for internal owners once we confirm assignments.

-- Jamie
